subject: Cup color is wrong
body:
Hi,

We got our custom cups a few weeks ago and finally opened them. The blue in our logo is noticeably lighter than our brand blue (Pantone 286). This is not what we paid for and honestly it's embarrassing to hand these to customers.

I want them reprinted.

Hannah Pruitt
Owner, The Daily Scoop
needs_human_reason: Complaint about a custom order from an upset customer asking for a reprint outside policy (rule 5).
summary: Owner of The Daily Scoop says the blue on her in-house digital cups (UQ-10391) is lighter than Pantone 286 and wants a reprint. Her proof stated close match / no PMS guarantee, and delivery was 24 days ago, so policy says it's not a defect.
draft_reply:
Hi Hannah,

I'm sorry the blue isn't what you were hoping for. Your cups are what your customers see, and I understand why this matters. Our owner is personally reviewing your order and will reach out to you directly.

So you have the full picture: your cups (order UQ-10391) were printed on our in-house digital press, which gives a close color match but can't guarantee an exact Pantone like 286. The proof approved on January 28 noted that, so I can't promise a reprint here, but our owner will go over the options with you.

For future orders, our USA partner prints with exact Pantone matching (minimum 10,000 cups), so your blue would match exactly.

If you can send a photo of the cups next to your brand blue, it will help with the review.

The UNIQ Supply Team
owner_note: In-house digital order; the proof (approved 1/28) stated close match, no PMS guarantee. Delivered 2/12, 24 days ago, past the 14-day defect window. Per policy it's not a defect. Your call on any goodwill gesture; upselling her to USA flexo with PMS for the next order fixes it for good.
